## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector leadership (Tech, Consumer Disc., Industrials positive vs Energy, Financials, Communication negative) and narrow top-performer concentration in Technology; regime supported by neutral breadth and concentrated leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: NOW (1W: +24.76% | 1M: +39.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +18.98% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +17.72% | 1M: +32.10%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary: F (1W: +27.58% | 1M: +44.28%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials: BA (1W: +5.25% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -10.47%) BELOW TREND. Financials lag: JPM (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND. Communication showing pockets of weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: F (1W: +27.58% | 1M: +44.28%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +24.76% | 1M: +39.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +18.98% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +17.72% | 1M: +32.10%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +60.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CME (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -10.47%) BELOW TREND, MDT (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -7.01%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +0.60%) CORRECTION, MO (1W: -5.60% | 1M: +2.02%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Energy/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest 1W movers: F (1W: +27.58%), NOW (1W: +24.76%), ORCL (1W: +18.98%), IBM (1W: +17.72%), QCOM (1W: +17.62%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: NVDA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -1.89% | 1M: +8.69%) CORRECTION and META (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -5.47%) RECOVERY — this multi-major divergence argues for caution and wait-for-confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leadership strong: AAPL (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +15.61%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +14.79% | 1M: +53.10%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -1.89% | 1M: +8.69%) CORRECTION show short-term weakness. Technology 1W: +7.88% | 1M: +19.05% (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft: JPM (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.44% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND; CME (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND. Financials 1W: -0.23% | 1M: -0.42% (20 stocks) — internal weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare slightly constructive but mixed: LLY (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +30.04%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +2.58%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -0.32%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare 1W: +0.25% | 1M: +2.93% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selectively: capture momentum in Above Trend tech/consumer names (NOW (1W: +24.76% | 1M: +39.91%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +18.98% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND, F (1W: +27.58% | 1M: +44.28%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to weak Energy and some Financials (XOM (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and cross-market divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +30.04%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +17.72% | 1M: +32.10%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +60.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +19.05%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +5.34%), Industrials (1W: +3.41% | 1M: +3.95%). BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -3.25%), Financials (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -0.42%), Communication (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -2.48%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION — reclaiming 1W gains would resolve the short-term pullback. Monitor AAPL (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +15.61%) ABOVE TREND for continued 1M strength as confirmatory signal. JPM (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize keeps Financials out of leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+65): Eli Lilly trial win; LLY (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +30.04%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. IBM (+50): Barclays initiate; IBM (1W: +17.72% | 1M: +32.10%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (+55): China orders/coverage; BA (1W: +5.25% | 1M: +3.14%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+55): new AI chip; NVDA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION — sentiment diverging from short-term price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (-55): headline on chip rally derailed yet AMD (1W: +14.79% | 1M: +53.10%) ABOVE TREND — news diverges from price (distribution risk to watch). GOOGL (-45): EU cloud rules; GOOGL (1W: -1.89% | 1M: +8.69%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. UNH (-50): legal headlines; UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +2.58%) CORRECTION — monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration. NOW (1W: +24.76% | 1M: +39.91%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +18.98% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: multi-major divergence (NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL CORRECTION, META RECOVERY) and sentiment/price mismatches (AMD negative headlines vs strong price) — watch for trend confirmation.
